subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the remaining fork copy for this Feishu reply-mention bug, or wait for the fork author to rework it?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the same-repository PR was closed unmerged after proof and safety blockers, while the remaining fork copy still claims the issue without being a safe target-repository landing path.

options.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the fork branch as source context but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and address the earlier mention-gating, root-routing, and proof concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as a known Feishu channel bug until a maintainer can prioritize the channel fix manually.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the fork branch as source context but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-handling and current-file maintenance make this the closest routing candidate for the safe fix shape.
